description: Comment input with a textarea and an inline @-mention autocomplete backed by a mention provider, plus submit and optional cancel actions; trims and emits the text on submit.

parameters.name: CanComment
parameters.description: Whether the current user may submit comments.

parameters.name: InitialText
parameters.description: Initial text used when the composer edits an existing entry.

parameters.name: IsBusy
parameters.description: Whether a comment operation is currently running.

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: Optional mention provider reused from the rich editor stack.

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Raised when the composer is cancelled.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Notifies the parent that the composer's draft state changed. The composer holds its text in a private field - no host can observe it through a parameter - so this callback is the only push channel. Fires ONLY when the TmCommentDraftState value actually changes (value-equality dedup), never on every keystroke. The state always reports IsEditorOpen=true and EditingCommentId=null; HasUnsavedContent is true once the text differs from the seeded InitialText and is not empty - a freshly seeded edit composer does not report an unsaved draft until the user actually types. Pair with HasUnsavedDraft for polling and DiscardDraftAsync for the discard.
